get.description: Return apps ordered by name with a total count. Supports a name filter and page controls. Requires app-modify-all permission.
Return all apps ordered by name. Requires app-modify-all permission.

post.description: Create an app bookmark. Requires app-create permission. Returns the app, including its ID and the legacy appId field. An empty pingUrl disables the custom ping URL.

get.description: Find apps whose names contain the query, ordered by name. Requires app-modify-all or board-modify-all permission; returns up to 100 results.
Return app IDs, names, icons, descriptions, destination URLs, and ping URLs for selection controls. Requires authentication.
Return an app by ID. Signed-in users can access all apps; anonymous access is limited to apps placed on public boards. Missing or inaccessible apps return not found.

patch.description: Update an app by ID. Requires app-modify-all permission. Supply all required app fields; an empty pingUrl clears the custom ping URL. Changing href invalidates linked integration caches.

delete.description: Delete an app by ID and invalidate linked integration caches. Requires app-full-all permission.

get.description: Return accessible boards with creator details, visibility, and the current user's desktop and mobile home flags. Anonymous callers can see public boards.

post.description: Create a board under a unique name with base and mobile layouts. Optional gutter column counts apply to the base layout. Requires board-create permission. Returns the board ID, name, base layout ID, and mobile layout ID; sets the creator's home board if none is selected.

Copy a board under a unique name and return the IDs of the copy and its base and mobile layouts. Requires board-create permission, view access to the source, and use access to its linked integrations. Widget configurations must be valid; boards containing Custom Widgets require admin permission.

patch.description: Change a board's name to a unique name. Requires full access to the board.
Make a board public or private. Requires full access to the board. A board selected as an instance desktop or mobile home board cannot be made private.

delete.description: Delete a board by ID. Requires full access to the board.

patch.description: Select the current user's desktop home board. Requires view access to the board.
Select the current user's mobile home board. Requires view access to the board.

get.description: Read editable board settings. Requires modify access to the board.

patch.description: Update the supplied appearance, metadata, background, custom CSS, or status settings. Omitted settings remain unchanged. Requires modify access to the board.

get.description: Read a board's Mobile, Base, and custom layouts ordered by breakpoint. Requires view access to the board.

put.description: Save the same responsive layout settings used by the dashboard editor. Requires modify access.

patch.description: Change one layout's name, column count, gutter column counts, or breakpoint and keep the other layouts. Items are rearranged as when saving all layouts. Requires modify access. The Mobile layout keeps breakpoint 0 and has no gutters.

post.description: Reset a Mobile or custom layout from the Base layout. Requires modify access.

get.description: Read a board's complete sections and items, including widget options and placements, in the shape accepted by PUT /api/boards/{id}/content. The board name and layouts are included to resolve layout IDs and are ignored when saving. Requires view access to the board.

put.description: Save the editor's complete sections and items arrays, including widget options and placements. Omitted items and sections are removed. Placements must fit their parent section's columns in each layout. Requires modify access; Custom Widget placement changes require admin access.

get.description: Return the users and groups with explicit permissions on a board, and the groups that inherit access through global board permissions. Requires full access to the board.

put.description: Replace all explicit user permissions on a board. Omitted users lose their explicit permission; each user can be listed once. Requires full access to the board.
Replace all explicit group permissions on a board. Omitted groups lose their explicit permission; each group can be listed once. Requires full access to the board.

post.summary: Add an item to a board
post.description: Add a widget or app to the first available position in the main canvas of each layout and return its item ID. Requires modify access to the board and use access to linked integrations. Widget configurations must be valid; placing Custom Widgets requires admin permission.

patch.summary: Move or resize one board item
patch.description: Update one item's position and size in one existing layout without replacing the board. Requires modify access. The item stays in its current section; out-of-bounds and overlapping placements are rejected.

get.description: Read one item's kind, widget options, advanced options, integration IDs, and placements in the shape used by the board content. Requires view access to the board.

patch.description: Replace the supplied widget options, advanced options, or integration IDs of one item without replacing the board. Omitted fields remain unchanged; the kind and placements cannot be changed here. Requires modify access to the board and use access to newly linked integrations; changing Custom Widget options requires admin permission.

delete.description: Remove one item with its placements and integration links without replacing the board. Requires modify access to the board.

get.description: Return every group with its position, home boards, owner ID, permissions, and members. A lower position takes precedence when resolving home boards. The reserved group named 'everyone' is joined by every user on sign-in, is not part of the group order, and cannot be renamed, deleted, or have its members changed. Requires admin permission.

post.description: Create a group without permissions or members at the end of the group order and return its ID. The name must be unique and cannot be 'everyone'. Requires admin permission.

get.description: Return a group with its position, home boards, owner, permissions, and members, including each member's authentication provider and whether the membership is managed locally. Memberships synchronized from an external provider (LDAP, or OIDC without local group management) cannot be changed. Requires admin permission.

patch.description: Change a group's name. The name must be unique and the 'everyone' group cannot be renamed. Requires admin permission.

delete.description: Delete a group with its permissions and memberships. The 'everyone' group cannot be deleted. Requires admin permission.

patch.description: Set or clear a group's desktop and mobile home boards. Omitted values remain unchanged and null clears a home board. Each board must exist; whether the group's members can view it is not checked. Also allowed for the 'everyone' group. Requires admin permission.

put.description: Set the order of all groups; the first group gets the lowest position and takes precedence when resolving home boards. List every group except 'everyone' exactly once. Requires admin permission.

Replace all permissions of a group and return the stored permissions. Omitted permissions are removed; implied permissions are not added. Also allowed for the 'everyone' group. Requires admin permission.

Replace the members of a group and return the resulting member IDs. Omitted members are removed. Users whose groups are synchronized from an external provider cannot be added or removed. Not allowed for the 'everyone' group. Requires admin permission.

post.description: Add a user to a group. Adding an existing member has no effect. Users whose groups are synchronized from an external provider (LDAP, or OIDC without local group management) cannot be added. Not allowed for the 'everyone' group. Requires admin permission.

delete.description: Remove a user from a group. Removing a user who is not a member has no effect. Users whose groups are synchronized from an external provider (LDAP, or OIDC without local group management) cannot be removed. Not allowed for the 'everyone' group. Requires admin permission.

get.description: Return the Homarr server version. Requires authentication.
Return invitations with their expiration dates and creators, ordered by expiration. Invite tokens are excluded. Requires admin permission and credentials authentication to be enabled.

post.description: Create a single-use invitation with the supplied expiration date and return its ID and registration token. Requires admin permission and credentials authentication to be enabled.

delete.description: Revoke an invitation by ID. Requires admin permission and credentials authentication to be enabled. Returns not found if the invitation does not exist.

get.description: Return instance desktop and mobile home board IDs and default status behavior. Requires admin permission.

patch.description: Update supplied instance board defaults and return the resulting settings. Changed home board IDs must reference public boards, or be null to clear the default. Requires admin permission.

post.description: Create a credentials account, assign the supplied groups, and return the new user's ID. Every group must exist; the user is not created otherwise. Requires admin permission and credentials authentication to be enabled. The username must be unique and password confirmation must match.

get.description: Return user IDs, names, email addresses, verification dates, profile images, and authentication providers. Requires admin permission.

put.description: Set a user's image to a base64 PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP data URL, or null to clear it. The data URL is limited to 350,000 characters. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.

get.description: Return user IDs, names, profile images, and email addresses for selection controls, optionally filtered by authentication provider. Requires authentication.

post.description: Find users whose names contain the query. Returns IDs, names, profile images, and email addresses, with up to 100 results. Requires admin permission.

get.description: Read every preference as structured JSON. Omit userId for the current user; reading another user requires admin permission.

patch.description: Update only supplied preferences and return the result. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null clears nullable references. Header fields and zones merge, while each supplied zone array replaces that zone. The complete merged header must retain unique items and account access. New board shortcuts must be accessible to the target user. Omit userId for yourself; another user requires admin permission. All validation completes before one write.

get.description: Return a user's profile, authentication provider, preferences, and group memberships. Users can read themselves; reading another user requires admin permission.

groupIds.description: IDs of the groups the user is a member of. Includes the everyone group once the user has signed in or was assigned to it on creation.

delete.description: Delete a user account. Users can delete themselves; deleting another user requires admin permission. Disabled in demo mode.

put.description: Replace the groups of a user and return the resulting group IDs. The everyone group membership is kept automatically. Fails when the user's groups are synchronized from an external provider. Requires admin permission.

Update a credentials account's username and email. Omitting the email keeps it; null or an empty string removes it. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission. External-provider profiles cannot be edited, and username changes are disabled in demo mode.

patch.description: Change a credentials account's password. Changing your own password requires the previous password, including for admins. Admins can reset another user's password without verifying their previous password. Disabled in demo mode.
Set or clear a user's desktop and mobile home boards. The caller must be able to view each selected board. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.

Deprecated: use PATCH /api/users/search-preferences instead. Updates the default search engine and supplied DuckDuckGo bang preference while preserving the new-tab preference. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.
Set a user's default search engine, new-tab behavior, and DuckDuckGo bang preference. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.
Set the current user's preferred color scheme. Requires authentication.
Enable or disable opening widget context menus with a right click for a user. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.

Replace a user's header layout and display preferences. New board shortcuts must reference boards the target user can view; existing shortcuts may be retained. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.
Deprecated: use PATCH /api/users/search-preferences instead. Enable or disable DuckDuckGo bangs for a user. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.

patch.summary: Change the first day of the week
patch.description: Set a user's preferred first day of the week. Users can update themselves; updating another user requires admin permission.

get.summary: Inspect a named custom root CA certificate
get.description: Return public metadata or null when absent. Requires admin permission. Does not return PEM contents.

post.summary: Ensure a named custom root CA certificate without overwriting
post.description: Accept one currently valid self-signed PEM root CA (64 KiB maximum). Identical bytes are idempotent; different existing bytes return CONFLICT. Requires admin permission.

post.summary: Proxy an integration API request using saved credentials
post.description: REST access to integration_request, Homarr's most powerful MCP tool. Call any API endpoint on a supported saved integration using its authentication and trusted certificates. Features not implemented in Homarr can still be used through this API or MCP if the upstream API supports them. Supply exactly one selector: integrationId, integrationName or integrationKind. Requires full integration access; DELETE also requires confirmed=true after user confirmation. Paths append to the saved URL. HTTP 200 can contain upstream errors: inspect ok, status and data. Limits: 10 KiB body, 16 KiB headers, 1 MiB response, 15 seconds. See https://homarr.dev/docs/management/api#call-any-integration-api-endpoint for the full contract.

integrationId.description: Saved integration ID from integration_all; supply exactly one selector

integrationName.description: Exact saved name; first full-access match ordered by name then ID

integrationKind.description: Integration type from integration_getKinds; first full-access match ordered by name then ID

path.description: API endpoint appended to the saved integration URL, including query parameters

body.description: JSON value by default; a string when bodyEncoding is raw

bodyEncoding.description: Use raw with a Content-Type header for form-encoded, XML or text bodies

headers.description: Optional non-authentication headers; stored authentication takes precedence

confirmed.description: Required for DELETE after the user confirms the deletion and its effects

get.summary: Test a saved integration using stored credentials
get.description: Requires full integration access. Runs the native connection check without changing saved configuration. Upstream authentication may establish a session. Success is a connection check, not widget or service acceptance. Failures expose only a safe category, not upstream errors or credentials.

Return every supported integration kind with its name, categories and secret kind options. An integration needs all secret kinds of one option in requiredSecrets; an empty option means no secrets are needed.
Return the integrations the caller can use, with the caller's use, interact and full access flags. Secrets are not included.

post.description: Create an integration with its secrets and optionally link or create an app. Secrets must cover one secret kind option from GET /api/integrations/kinds. The connection is tested before saving unless skipConnectionTest is set; a failed test returns BAD_REQUEST with the failure category. Requires integration-create permission, and app-create permission for a new app.

get.description: Return an integration with its linked app and stored secret kinds. Secret values are only returned for public kinds such as usernames, all others are null; updatedAt shows when each secret was last saved. Requires full access to the integration.

put.description: Replace the name, URL, linked app and secrets of an integration. Each listed secret kind is kept: a value replaces it, null keeps the stored value (only when the URL is unchanged); unlisted kinds are deleted. The connection is tested before saving unless skipConnectionTest is set; a failed test returns BAD_REQUEST with the failure category. Requires full access to the integration.

delete.description: Delete an integration with its secrets and permissions. Widgets lose the integration. Requires full access to the integration.

get.description: Return the users and groups with explicit permissions on an integration, and the groups that inherit access through global integration permissions. Requires full access to the integration.

put.description: Replace all explicit user permissions on an integration. Omitted users lose their explicit permission; each user can be listed once. Requires full access to the integration.
Replace all explicit group permissions on an integration. Omitted groups lose their explicit permission; each group can be listed once. Requires full access to the integration.

issues.description: An array of issues that were responsible for the error
An array of issues that were responsible for the error
An array of issues that were responsible for the error
An array of issues that were responsible for the error
An array of issues that were responsible for the error

apikey.name: ApiKey
apikey.description: API key which can be obtained in the Homarr administration dashboard
